assumptions: Peak request proxy uses 0.25 per peak active client per second.
summary: Publish prebuilt pages through Cloudflare Pages. The site needs neither a dynamic API nor a runtime database.

architecture_decision.justification: Build public pages ahead of time. The content and read-heavy workload can be served as immutable files without an application process.
data_flow: Build published content and version the output.
Serve the release from the selected static ingress.
Read public assets directly in the browser.

alternatives.why_not: An always-on application and data store would add operations without a runtime write path.

tradeoffs: Content changes require a new build and release.

frontend.justification: Pre-renders content and ships JavaScript only for interactive islands. Content pages can be built before traffic arrives. The team already lists javascript.

alternatives.why_not: It scored 4 points lower on combined fit. Content pages can be built before traffic arrives. The alternative gained points on requirements.seo_critical.

selected: Content pages can be built before traffic arrives.

tradeoffs: Interactive pages still need deliberate hydration boundaries.

backend.justification: The public site can be built ahead of time and served as files.

alternatives.why_not: A server would add cost and patching without application writes or authentication.

tradeoffs: New requirements may introduce this layer.

database.justification: Keep content in version-controlled files or Markdown.

alternatives.why_not: A live database adds no value for build-time pages.

tradeoffs: New requirements may introduce this layer.

hosting.justification: Delivers prebuilt public assets without maintaining an application server. Public files do not need an always-on server. Managed compute reduces infrastructure maintenance for the team. Fits the requested managed cloud model. Cloudflare Pages serves static requests without metering them against Functions quotas. Placement: public edge.

alternatives.why_not: It scored 2 points lower on combined fit. Cloudflare Pages serves static requests without metering them against Functions quotas.

selected: Cloudflare Pages serves static requests without metering them against Functions quotas.

tradeoffs: Free-plan limits apply. This profile has no private data plane.

supporting.justification: Serve public build assets through the hosting provider and keep private data out of the published bundle.

alternatives.why_not: The bundled delivery path avoids a separate distribution.

tradeoffs: Public assets are cached internationally and subject to platform quotas.

excluded_hosting.reason: Reserved for small public web apps and HTTP APIs with persistent reads.

assumptions: Illustrative monthly USD operating band. Inputs are sizing proxies, not a measured request or billing forecast.
Peak proxy: 50 concurrent clients, 13 requests or realtime events per second and 1 GB total data.
Placement: public edge. Starts with modest regional capacity and backups.
Excludes taxes, team labor, initial hardware, domain purchases and transaction fees. Media and OTP allowances are modeled separately when requested.
Heavy internet egress is outside the baseline. Provide a monthly estimate to price it explicitly.
Assumes build and transfer remain within public static hosting quotas.
